notes:
CRM notes and call snippets:
- Company: mid-market B2B SaaS (product search + recommendations). Strong focus on SERP quality; current stack = Elasticsearch + learned-to-rank model (offline).
- POC scope: evaluate Redwood hosted rerank endpoint as a drop-in replacement for current scoreer (offline batch) and as candidate for online reranker in low-latency surface.
- Technical asks (from Eng Lead, Anita Kumar): latency target 25-50ms median at 32 concurrent re-rank calls, throughput ~250k requests/day, offline scoring of 10M queries/month, ability to run offline evals (NDCG@10, MRR) against current model.
- Model preferences: prefer open LLMs (Llama 2/Redwood-curated) with option for quantized variants. Want ability to pin model versions and fallback to smaller model for cost-savings.
- Security: require SSO (SAML), audit logs retention 1yr, KMS integration, contract language on data residency for EU customers. Mentioned procurement play: start on Hosted API then migrate to Dedicated when committed throughput and SLA needed.
- Quotes: "If we can match our offline NDCG and show 30% cost improvement for batch reranks, we can greenlight Dedicated." — PM (Jordan Lee).
- POC details: Diego running offline scoring job using Redwood hosted batch endpoint and local offline harness; evaluation scripts in Drive link. Initial offline NDCG within 3% of baseline but observed headroom on tail relevance.
- Observability ask: want per-route token and latency breakdown, and a way to hook existing tracing for A/B comparisons. Also want ability to seed reranker with candidate features + original ranking score.
- Commercial: finance asked for committed monthly throughput tiers for Dedicated pricing. Suggested ARR bracket submitted for procurement.
- Next tactical items: create canonical eval set (5k queries + relevance judgments), run 3 model variants (full, quantized, small fallback), collect NDCG/MRR + per-query latency distribution, and draft Dedicated pricing scenario for 12-month commit.
- Notes style: shorthand, action-oriented. See linked docs for POC scripts and pricing ask.
